title: System tasks: every supported kind end to end on new seeds, under a gate fixed before any run, with sealed seeds read once
request: The owner asked for a benchmark of the whole system as one.
spec: Each supported kind's acceptance (project, five stages, every decision checked) on dev seeds new to every earlier run and on sealed seeds read once, judged by system_gate_v1 written in code first; no model, no euro.
plan: reuse the kinds' acceptance as the task
fix the kinds, the seeds and the gate in code
dev first, then the sealed seeds once

decisions.decision: Reuse the kinds' acceptance instead of writing new tasks
decisions.why: each acceptance is already a whole-system task with planted traps; new invented tasks would repeat it

decisions.decision: Seeds new to the kinds campaign and a sealed pair read once
decisions.why: the kinds campaign had seen its own seeds; a gate is only evidence on cases no change was tuned on

change: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/system_tasks/ (new), evidence/campaigns/system_tasks_v1/ (manifest, SYS-001 dev), dclab_rnd/bench/__init__.py (the layer and the free runner), docs/guides/BENCHMARK.md, tests/test_system_tasks.py.

findings.defect: The kinds campaign had no gate
findings.scenario: the bench read kinds_v1 as measurements without a verdict
findings.cause: the campaign recorded decisions per seed and nothing judged them as a suite
findings.fix: a suite over new seeds with a gate written first

measurements.name: the dev seeds
measurements.result: every task passed, every kind on both seeds
limits: invented replicas with planted traps, not real data
the engine's rules only, no model

outcome: The whole system has a gated suite of its own; the dev seeds pass and predict the sealed run.
lessons: a gate turns a pile of passing checks into a claim that can fail
risks: the replicas plant the traps each kind expects; real data hides traps nobody planted
